scope: Bounded correction for a native Home Assistant startup state where the hass object exists but its theme registry has not arrived. Current installation/cache references advance to v1.4.1. This patch does not change palette values, supplied artwork or device configuration.

previous_evidence.meaning: Earlier rename and artwork-replacement source review remains unchanged. Its local outcomes are not a fresh startup regression result.

subsequent_ci.scope: Successful v1.4.0 CI did not include the subsequently observed null-theme-registry startup case.

reported_defect.source: Parent observed the failure during live validation after the renamed release.
reported_defect.trigger: The native application publishes hass while hass.themes is null; companion code dereferenced the absent registry.
reported_defect.effect: A TypeError interrupts the companion update. A present hass object alone is not proof that theme settings are ready.

implementation_contract: Read optional theme state and its nested registry defensively in companion activation and settings selection.
Keep colour controls disabled and describe their loading state while the theme registry is absent; do not present a loading registry as a missing-theme installation.
Resume normal controls and scoped styling when the registry becomes available, using existing native events and polling/lifecycle behavior.
Preserve existing safe/recovery-mode restrictions and avoid emitting a theme-change action while the registry is absent.
Use v1.4.1 module/resource cache references; retained compatibility filenames and existing household configuration remain unchanged.

independent_source_review.findings: No additional defect found in the bounded null-registry correction. Optional reads cover both outer theme data and its nested registry. Settings distinguish loading from missing installed themes; absent data deactivates project branding until normal updates restore it.
independent_source_review.regression_scope: The fixture exercises undefined/null outer theme data, an empty pending object and a null nested map. It asserts disabled/loading controls, native identity fallback, automatic recovery, preserved dark preference, no unintended theme-change events and no page errors. This is local fixture evidence, not a live cold-start certification.
independent_source_review.chart_contract: The only energy-charts.ts change permits null in the HassContext themes type. Its accesses already use optional chaining; chart rendering, options and data behavior are unchanged.

node_tests.evidence_source: Parent executed the full local Node suite after the frozen correction.

theme_settings_browser.evidence_source: Parent executed the complete focused theme-settings suite, including the new absent/null-registry recovery regression.

validation.recording_boundary: Full CI, release, Pages and actual live patch acceptance will be recorded in the follow-up pull request and deployment receipt. The original v1.4.0 review remains byte-identical.
